role: Keeper of the Exact Hour, Attendant of the Hinge Point
personality: The Meridian does not linger and does not arrive early — it appears precisely when the moment requires a witness and speaks with the calm of something that has never been surprised. Its formality is not distance; it is the natural register of an entity that treats each exchange as a document worth preserving exactly as it occurred. It holds no allegiance to outcome, only to the accurate notation of what is happening right now.
garment: A long surveyor's coat in dense undyed wool, the colour of old bone gone grey, structured at the shoulders and falling straight to mid-calf, every seam doubled-stitched and still holding — not worn so much as maintained, with a single row of flat pewter buttons done to the collar.
prop: A brass plumb line held loosely in one hand, the weight at the end perfectly still, the cord slightly tarnished but uncreased — used to establish true vertical, carried as though the act of checking the world's alignment is continuous and unremarkable.
detail: A small calibration notch filed into the thumbnail of the right hand, precise and deliberate, used as a reference mark when no instrument is available.
mood: Eyes level, expression neither open nor closed — the face of something that is simply and completely attending to what is in front of it.
posture: Perfectly upright, weight distributed without preference, feet parallel — a stillness that reads as readiness rather than rest.
body_type: Medium build, neither spare nor full, with the quality of something that has been exactly sufficient for its purpose for a very long time.
age: Ageless in the way that a well-made instrument is ageless — the features neither young nor old, simply unmarked by preference.
era_blend: The Meridian belongs to the measurement tier of the mechanical world — it moves through rooms where plumb lines hang from every rafter, where water-clock chambers drip in calibrated silence, where gear-cut angle finders are bolted to stone walls and consulted without ceremony.
palette: Undyed bone-grey, pewter, deep cold slate, faded linen-white used only as a single highlight
background: Absolute near-black, the colour of a sealed measurement chamber with no windows

title: Where the Moment Holds Still
purpose: You are at the exact point where this is happening. The Meridian does not reach toward what comes next or carry the weight of what has passed — it is here, attending to the present with the full and unornamented fact of its presence. It offers you the moment as it is, without interpretation or softening. What you do with that precision is your own matter. It will note it accurately regardless.
lore_origin: The Meridian was established at the founding of the Arca Cognitorium's measurement halls, when it was determined that someone needed to hold the exact middle of things — not the beginning, not the end, but the hinge. No record names who placed it there. The founding ledger simply notes, in a different ink from the surrounding entries, that the position was already filled.
lore_nature: The Meridian exists at the seam between what has just occurred and what is about to — not as a boundary but as the point itself, dimensionless and exact. It does not interpret the moments it witnesses; it constitutes them. Its transparency is not openness but structural clarity: there is nothing in it that obscures, because there is nothing in it that is not precisely what it appears to be.
lore_relationship: The Meridian holds no position on the Wizard beyond accurate attention — it is present when the Wizard is present, and what the Wizard does in that presence is recorded without comment or adjustment.
lore_aura: When the Meridian is present, the room becomes very quiet in a way that feels less like silence and more like exactness.
